about_md:
I am a Computer Engineering Technology graduate from Politeknik Negeri Semarang (GPA 3.84, cum laude) who builds backends real people depend on, not just code that runs on my own laptop.

At PT Indosat Ooredoo Hutchison (Circle Java) I built and optimised field-sales backends with FastAPI and Laravel, used by up to 500 active users, and shipped WhatsApp and Telegram daily-report chatbots that surface real-time outlet performance.

Outside work I combine backend, data, and AI: FTTH sales-data validation with YOLO26 and PaddleOCR, a PySpark pipeline over 1.2 million rows for drinking-water quality prediction, and an ESP32 soil-monitoring device. I like automating slow, error-prone manual work and replacing it with something that can be measured.
headline: Software Engineer & Backend Developer
summary_short: Software engineer working end to end: data modelling, APIs, and applied AI that hold up in the field.
tagline: I turn manual, error-prone processes into systems people actually use.
